name: texture
meaning: non-NULL means the sprite is loadable; Sprite_Draw returns immediately when it is 0

name: texPage
meaning: texture page index; +4 gives the RenderPoly.type written to g_draw2dPolyType

name: widthMinus1
meaning: the stored value is (bitmap width - 1), not the width. Same for +0xA

name: u
meaning: sub-rect origin U within the 256px texture page

name: v
meaning: sub-rect origin V within the 256px texture page
